cases.derivation: headroom 8,000 - 5,000 = 3,000. O1 5,000 > 3,000 and the 60% receipt is not relied on -> ESCALATE. O2 EUR 2,012.85 incl. fee = USD 2,184 <= 3,000 -> CONVERT_AND_PAY.
